Nina (AE): Customer (BlueHarbor) POC ask: BYOIP for egress, single /29 allowlist, and deterministic regional failover. Can we do Private deploy without peering their CIDRs into our account?
Carlos (Solutions): Two patterns: (1) PrivateLink interface endpoints -> minimal route changes, ENIs in their subnets. (2) Deploy connector in their VPC (customer-managed) -> full srcIP preservation. BYOIP only affects egress EIPs; if they need egress to come from their advertised range, connector-in-VPC is simplest.
Rhea (NetOps): If they insist on our managed connector but with fixed egress EIPs, we can allocate a reserved EIP block and NAT SNAT; note this breaks srcIP. Tradeoff must be documented. For failover: recommend DNS-based region failover + healthchecks, or TGW with route priorities for faster cutover.
Sam (Security): Security Q: short paste for questionnaire?
Carlos (Solutions): Paste below (short):
"Network Architecture (Private Deployment): Redwood supports (A) Connector deployed into customer VPC (recommended for source-IP preservation and BYOIP egress). Connector communicates outbound to Redwood control plane over TLS (443). (B) PrivateLink via Interface Endpoints: minimal routing changes; app traffic terminates on ENIs in customer subnets. Required firewall rules: allow outbound TCP/443 to Redwood control-plane EIP ranges (provided during onboarding). If using PrivateLink, update security groups to allow app->endpoint TLS. No inbound public exposure required."
Rhea (NetOps): Minimal SG snippet for their runbook:
# allow app -> endpoint ENI
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-app --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.20.0/24
# allow connector -> control-plane egress (example range)
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-connector --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 198.51.100.0/29

Nina (AE): Procurement Q: delta vs Dedicated? Any one-time infra fees?
Carlos (Solutions): Pricing note: Private deployment = platform license + onboarding (one-time) + monthly connector fee. If customer hosts connector in their VPC, infra VM/GW cost is on them; our invoice covers license/support. Rough POC estimate ~1.15-1.3x hosted for small trials. I'll follow up with formal quote.

Rhea (NetOps): Will post EIP /29 and a 60s healthcheck TTL suggestion within 90min.
Sam (Security): I'll own log retention and packet capture follow-up.
